question: 前人有没有现成的、可直接迁移的建模，把充电发生在哪个时段写进电动车路径模型的目标函数和约束？
facts: Lin et al. (2021) use binary vehicle-station-period charging/discharging variables and period-specific prices in a joint routing objective.
Shi et al. (2025) integrate a continuous charging interval over piecewise time-of-use prices in a mixed-fleet routing objective.
Yao et al. (2023) connect continuous arrival time, partial charging amount, charging-period occupancy, charging-period start, and spatio-temporal charging prices.
Miyabe et al. (2025) use a 5-minute time-expanded routing and charging model whose objective multiplies time-indexed grid carbon intensity by grid-supplied charging energy.

Cheng et al. (2022) provide the time-indexed carbon objective, SOC recursion, individual charging-power bounds, station transformer capacity, and session-window constraint, but do not include routing.
No included paper simultaneously contains mixed fleet, multi-depot, multi-trip, hard customer time windows, and both depot and public charging locations.
judgment_A_route_changed: yes; direct quantitative evidence is Lin et al. (2021), PDF pp.25-26, where Scheme B is approximately 32 km longer on average than Scheme A
judgment_B_worse_or_unchanged: yes; report.md Section 8 records unchanged routes, higher distance or objective, reduced delivered energy, and modeling/heuristic failure modes with paper-page evidence
judgment_C_scale: answered per paper in report.md Section 9; no cross-paper universal scalability threshold is inferred
